coded_pairs.note: Azure answers box 12 as a code leaf and an amount leaf per entry; joined, each is one figure `12.<code>` (spec 079 FR-018). Measured on a stored read, engagement 16 document 480, 2026-10-02.

document.notes: Box 9 is printed with no caption on the 2025 form (reserved; it carried no label). Box 14 'Other' is deliberately unroutable free text: the Instructions for Employee say employers 'may use this box to report information such as state disability insurance taxes withheld, union dues, uniform payments, health insurance premiums deducted, nontaxable income, educational assistance payments, or a member of the clergy's parsonage allowance and utilities.' There is NO 14a/14b split on the 2025 form. The 2025 form prints NO box 12 codes TA or TP; codes run A through II with I, O, U, X and CC unused. Box 12 is declared ONCE with its full code table, and each code is addressed `12.<code>` (the coded pair the reader joins); 12a-12d are the four physical slots on the form. Box 13's three checkboxes are 13-statutory-employee / 13-retirement-plan / 13-third-party-sick-pay and box 15 is 15-state / 15-state-id; the duplicate ids '12 code T', '12 code W', '13' and '15' were removed (spec 080 F-045).

extraction.note: Azure's W-2 model answers the federal money boxes by MEANING rather than by number, so `fields` is what turns `WagesTipsAndOtherCompensation` into box 1. Measured on real dev data: without it this document placed nothing at all. Box 13's three checkboxes are answered as `IsStatutoryEmployee`, `IsRetirementPlan` and `IsThirdPartySickPay`, and box 12 as `AdditionalInfo[i].LetterCode` / `AdditionalInfo[i].Amount` — MEASURED on a stored read of engagement 16 (document 480, 2026-10-02: code D with an amount), which overturns this note's earlier *every observed value was null*. Box 12 is joined into `12.<code>` by the leadsheet's coded-pair reader (`coded_pairs` on this document), not by this field map.
